title: The Solana Foundation takes a majority stake in CoinGecko, a popular crypto price-tracking platform with 18M registered users (Francisco Rodrigues/CoinDesk)
summary: Francisco Rodrigues / CoinDesk: The Solana Foundation takes a majority stake in CoinGecko, a popular crypto price-tracking platform with 18M registered users — The Solana Foundation has taken a majority interest in CoinGecko, one of the crypto ecosystem's most popular price-tracking platforms.
